item.name: Ghost Scepter

effects.title: Ghost Form
effects.text: You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

notes: Ends if you become Debuff Immune, and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with all Ghost Scepter upgrades.
item.lore: Imbues the wielder with a ghostly presence, allowing them to evade physical damage.
